name: Hallowed Letter
label: Item
description: Priestess Anetta calls young priests from Northshire Valley to Northshire Abbey. Her letter begins their study of the Holy Light.
intro: Priestess Anetta calls young priests from Northshire Valley to Northshire Abbey. Her letter begins their study of the Holy Light.

p: The Hallowed Letter bears Priestess Anetta’s personal mark and reaches fledgling priests after their first trials against the kobold camps of Northshire Valley. She sees the Holy Light’s spark within each novice and urges them to enter the abbey and dedicate themselves to its service. Dark forces still linger across Azeroth in the wake of the Third War. The priesthood gathers those able to heal, protect, and guide an empire struggling to keep order.
